title: The Role of Simulation in Robotics Development
description: Simulation has become an indispensable tool in robotics research and development. Before any robot takes its first physical step or grasps its first object, extensive testing typically occurs in simulated environments. This approach addresses fundamental challenges in robotics development: physical robots are expensive, experiments are time-consuming, and failures can damage hardware or harm people.
